map.篮球得分与篮板效率（本页代码口径）：投篮/三分/罚球命中率=命中÷出手；有效投篮: Basketball scoring and rebounding efficiency (page's actual logic): FG / 3P / FT percentage = made ÷ attempted; effective field-goal eFG% = (FG made + 0.5 × 3P made) ÷ FG attempts; true shooting TS% = points ÷ (2 × (FG attempts + 0.44 × FT attempts)); rebound rate TRB% = rebounds ÷ (team + opponent total rebounds), with offensive / defensive rebound rates using the corresponding denominators; per-48-minute values = value × 48 ÷ minutes; GameScore = points + 0.4 × FG made − 0.7 × FG attempts − 0.4 × (FT attempts − FT made) + 0.7 × offensive rebounds + 0.3 × defensive rebounds + steals + 0.7 × assists + 0.7 × blocks − 0.4 × fouls − turnovers. Validation: minutes ≤0 is flagged invalid; ratios with a zero denominator display "—". Criteria: TS% ≥0.650 elite efficiency, ≥0.580 efficient, ≥0.550 qualified, ≥0.500 average, otherwise inefficient; GameScore ≥30 MVP level, ≥25 star level, ≥20 excellent, ≥15 qualified starter, ≥10 rotation player, otherwise role player.
